companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Parcel Forward makes cross-border shipping simple for online shops.

We connect shops with local carriers across Europe so parcels move from warehouse to doorstep at the right speed and cost.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
We are growing, and so is the regulatory and contractual work that comes with a cross-border logistics platform. We are looking for a senior generalist to own legal, compliance, data protection and AI governance topics. 

This is a hands-on individual contributor role: contract review, GDPR questions and compliance training.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
This is what you need to succeed:

  • Experience in compliance, privacy or contract negotiation; a law degree is a plus 
  • 5+ years in a generalist legal, compliance or privacy role 
  • Fluent German and English

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
What we offer:

Flexible and hybrid work: an office in Berlin, flexible remote set-up and working hours.
